logic_sets.description: Turbine trip on condenser low-low vacuum. Trip initiates when U1-PT-CND-4201 exceeds 3.50 inHgA (lower-lower setpoint). This setpoint was NOT reached during the event; condenser pressure peaked at 2.10 inHgA.
Turbine load runback on condenser backpressure above 2.00 inHgA. Runback rate 5% per minute. Actuated at 13:26:10 during this event.

barrier_states.rationale: Turbine trip barrier remained held throughout the event. The 3.50 inHgA lower-lower trip setpoint was not reached. Runback was actuated at 2.10 inHgA per AOP-10 and successfully halted vacuum degradation before the trip threshold.
